lines.en: label bar20:
scene scoutredux1
I walk into the bar and immediately put my head down as Sara and Sana are locked in a mildly heated argument behind the counter.
lines.zh: 我走进酒吧，Sara 和 Sana 正在吧台后面争得有点凶，我立刻低下了头。

lines.en: I worry for a moment that something like this could potentially drive customers away, but then I remember where I am and decide it's best to not worry at all.
lines.zh: 有那么一瞬间我担心这种事会把客人吓跑，随即想起自己身在何处，决定完全不必操心。

lines.en: I am a little offended, however, seeing as my presence has not put a stop to whatever debate those two are having.
lines.zh: 不过我倒是有点受伤，因为我这个人的出现居然没能让那两位的争论停下来。

lines.en: Granted, I'm probably not even viewed as a customer anymore to them.
lines.zh: 话说回来，对她们来说，我大概早就不算什么客人了。

lines.en: Now, I’m just a dude who shows up, has a beer or two, and then proceeds to either lecture or have sex with one of them.
lines.zh: 现在的我，不过是个来了之后喝上一两杯啤酒，然后就开始说教、或者跟她们其中一个上床的家伙。

lines.en: scene scoutredux2

lines.zh: : 嗯……你、你好……

lines.en: : You didn’t...hear anything just now did you?
lines.zh: : 你刚才……什么都没听到吧？

lines.en: : Hey, Sana.
lines.zh: : 嗨，Sana。

lines.en: : I didn't hear what it was about, but I could definitely tell it was some sort of argument.
lines.zh: : 我没听清在吵什么，但我能肯定那是在吵架。

lines.en: : Is everything okay?
lines.zh: : 一切都还好吗？

lines.en: : Mhm...Everything is fine...I...umm...
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯……一切都好……我……呃……

lines.en: : I don’t have to work tonight...
lines.zh: : 我今晚……不用上班……

lines.en: : Sara’s going to take care of the bar on her own?
lines.zh: : Sara 要一个人顾店？

lines.en: : I...guess so...
lines.zh: : 我……大概是吧……

lines.en: : I have...an...umm...important mission to take care of...
lines.zh: : 我有……一个……呃……重要的任务要去完成……

lines.en: : A mission this late?
lines.zh: : 这么晚了还有任务？

lines.en: scene scoutredux3
: And, um...it's...a mission for you too, actually...
lines.zh: : 而且，呃……其实……这也是给你的任务……

lines.en: : Wait, what? Why? I just wanted to relax. Why do I have a mission now?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？为什么？我只想放松一下。怎么我也有任务了？

lines.en: : Because that's just...how things worked out...
lines.zh: : 因为事情……就是变成这样了嘛……

lines.en: : Well, can you tell me what it is? Or are you just going to stay cryptic about it?
lines.zh: : 那你能告诉我是什么任务吗？还是说你就打算一直这么神神秘秘的？

lines.en: scene scoutredux4
: I-I’ll tell you! I just need to go get dressed first!
lines.zh: : 我、我会说的！我只是得先去换身衣服！

lines.en: : Please...wait a moment! My clothes are...upstairs...
lines.zh: : 请……等我一下！我的衣服……在楼上……

lines.en: scene scoutredux1
Sana quickly dashes past me and up the stairs to her mother’s apartment.
lines.zh: Sana 迅速从我身边跑过，上了楼梯，去了她妈妈的公寓。

lines.en: It’s quiet enough in here that even the faint tapping of her footsteps manages to bring life to this dying bar.
lines.zh: 这里安静得连她那轻微的脚步声都能给这家快倒闭的酒吧带来一丝生气。

lines.en: scene scoutredux5
: Hiya, stranger~
lines.zh: : 你好呀，陌生~人~

lines.en: : What the hell was that all about?
lines.zh: : 那到底是怎么回事？

lines.en: : Are you talking about our argument? Or about the mission?
lines.zh: : 你是指我们吵架的事？还是指那个任务？

lines.en: : Both, I guess?
lines.zh: : 我想，两个都是？

lines.en: : Well, the two of them are connected, so I'll just go ahead explain the whole thing to you.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这两件事是连着的，那我就干脆把整件事都跟你说了吧。

lines.en: : This ‘mission’ involves checking out another bar in the area that’s been doing...admittedly better than this one.
lines.zh: : 这个“任务”是要去打探附近另一家酒吧——那家店的经营状况……说实话比这家好。

lines.en: : Like, much better.
lines.zh: : 好得多。

lines.en: : Like it's not even close.
lines.zh: : 根本不是一个量级的。

lines.en: : So it’s a...scouting mission?
lines.zh: : 所以这是……侦察任务？

lines.en: scene scoutredux6
: Yeah, exactly! You two are going to go check out that bar and see what {i}they’re{/i} doing that we’re not.
lines.zh: : 对，就是这样！你们俩要去那家酒吧看看，{i}他们{/i}做了哪些我们没做的事。

lines.en: : Not sure if you’ve realized this, but my livelihood kinda depends on this place.
lines.zh: : 不知道你有没有意识到，我全家的生计可都指着这家店。

lines.en: : Unless a certain someone wants to start taking care of me, of course.
lines.zh: : 当然了，除非某个谁愿意开始养我。

lines.en: : I'm good, thanks.
lines.zh: : 我很好，谢谢。

lines.en: scene scoutredux7
: At least pretend to think about it, jerk!
lines.zh: : 你好歹装作考虑一下啊，混蛋！

lines.en: : That aside, are you sure it’s okay to send Sana to a rival bar?
lines.zh: : 先不说这个，你真的放心让 Sana 去对手的店里？

lines.en: scene scoutredux8
: That’s exactly what we were arguing about! I was supposed to go with you instead!
lines.zh: : 我们刚才就是在吵这个！本来应该是我跟你们去的！

lines.en: : The two of {i}us{/i} going to a bar together would make a lot more sense than you going with my daughter! {i}And{/i} it would give us the chance to get to know one another better!
lines.zh: : {i}我们{/i}两个一起去酒吧，总比你带着我女儿去合理多了吧！{i}而且{/i}还能顺便让我们俩更了解彼此！

lines.en: : This wasn’t a scouting mission at all, was it? You just wanted to get drunk with me.
lines.zh: : 这根本就不是什么侦察任务吧？你只是想跟我出去喝酒。

lines.en: scene scoutredux6
: I mean...that's not {i}all{/i} I wanted to do.
lines.zh: : 我是说……我想做的也{i}不只是{/i}那个。

lines.en: : That sentence makes the idea of you allowing your daughter to go in your place significantly more disturbing.
lines.zh: : 这句话让你“同意女儿替你去”这件事，听起来诡异多了。

lines.en: scene scoutredux8
: It’s not like I {i}wanted{/i} to! She just seemed weirdly devoted to not letting me follow you out tonight for some reason!
lines.zh: : 我又不是{i}自愿{/i}的！只是她不知道为什么，今晚死活不让我跟着你出门！

lines.en: : That’s...interesting.
lines.zh: : 这……有点意思。

lines.en: scene scoutredux9
: {i}I{/i} think she's just jealous.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}觉得她只是在吃醋。

lines.en: : I think it’s less jealousy and more feeling weird about the situation.
lines.zh: : 我觉得与其说是吃醋，不如说是她觉得这局面很奇怪。

lines.en: : Wouldn’t you feel odd if your teacher in [high_school] started dating your mom?
lines.zh: : 要是你[high_school]的老师开始跟你妈妈约会，你会不会觉得别扭？

lines.en: : Well, yeah. It would have been weird if we were {i}both{/i} dating him.
lines.zh: : 嗯，会啊。要是我们俩{i}同时{/i}在跟他交往，那才叫奇怪。

lines.en: : I'm sorry, what?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你说什么？

lines.en: scene scoutredux10
: Oh, it's not really a big deal.
lines.zh: : 哦，这也没什么大不了的。

lines.en: : It was one of those secret relationship things. No one ever found out about it.
lines.zh: : 就是那种地下恋情。从来没人发现过。

lines.en: : Well, at least...not right away...
lines.zh: : 至少……没有马上被发现……

lines.en: : But it was inevitable that someone eventually would and-
lines.zh: : 不过迟早有人会发现，然后——

lines.en: scene scoutredux5
: Wait, why are we even talking about this? That's definitely not something I want to discuss with you yet.
lines.zh: : 等等，我们为什么要聊这个？这绝对不是我现在想跟你讨论的事。

lines.en: : If only we were able to go out for drinks...
lines.zh: : 要是现在我们能出去喝一杯就好了……

lines.en: Sara pauses for a moment and reflects on her past, but the reflection doesn't last long as the same faint tapping of footsteps from earlier makes its way back down the stairs.
lines.zh: Sara 顿了一下，回想起自己的过去，不过这段回忆没持续多久——先前那阵轻微的脚步声又从楼梯上下来了。

lines.en: : I’ll see you later, Sara. I’ll be sure to let you know how your rival bar is.
lines.zh: : 回头见，Sara。我一定把对手那家店的情况告诉你。

lines.en: : Be good to my daughter. Don't let her drink {i}too{/i} much.
lines.zh: : 对我女儿好一点。别让她喝{i}太{/i}多。

lines.en: : It was a joke. You can laugh.
lines.zh: : 那是个玩笑。你可以笑的。

lines.en: scene scoutredux2r
: Um...I’m sorry it took me so long...I couldn’t find my socks...
lines.zh: : 嗯……对不起我花了这么久……我找不到我的袜子……

lines.en: : It’s fine. I got the details from your mom. Do you know where this place is?
lines.zh: : 没事。我从你妈妈那儿了解情况了。你知道那地方在哪儿吗？

lines.en: : Mhm...It’s not that far from here...
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯……离这儿不远……

lines.en: : You can just...follow me...
lines.zh: : 你只要……跟着我就行……

lines.en: scene black
Sana and I exit the bar.
lines.zh: Sana 和我走出了酒吧。

lines.en: I turn around to look at Sara as we make our way through the door-
lines.zh: 我们穿过门口时，我回头看了一眼 Sara——

lines.en: But the smile she wore just moments ago has vanished.
lines.zh: 可她片刻之前还挂着的笑容已经消失了。

lines.en: And all I can do is imagine why.
lines.zh: 而我只能去想象那是为了什么。

lines.en: scene sanabartwenty1
Sana and I take a seat at a table after being led over by a hostess around her mother’s age.
lines.zh: 一位跟她妈妈年纪相仿的女招待领位后，Sana 和我在一张桌前坐下。

lines.en: Right off the bat, you can tell this place has a much...{i}warmer{/i} atmosphere.
lines.zh: 一眼就能看出，这地方的氛围要……{i}温暖{/i}得多。

lines.en: In fact, I don't even know if I'd call this place a {i}bar{/i} considering everyone seems to be eating as well.
lines.zh: 事实上，看大家都在吃饭，我都不确定该不该管这地方叫{i}酒吧{/i}。

lines.en: I pick up a menu to confirm my suspicions and don't see the word {i}bar{/i} anywhere, so I ascertain that Sara's source of intel is just as bad as her management skills and toss away my gameplan for the night.
lines.zh: 我拿起菜单想确认自己的猜测，结果哪儿都没看到“{i}酒吧{/i}”这个词，于是我断定 Sara 的情报能力跟她的经营水平一样烂，顺手把今晚的计划扔到了一边。

lines.en: Sorry, Sara. Your mission was inherently flawed.
lines.zh: 抱歉了，Sara。你这个任务从根上就有问题。

lines.en: : What’s up?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？

lines.en: : Nothing’s up...I just...wanted to say...thanks for coming with me...
lines.zh: : 没什么……我只是……想说……谢谢你陪我来……

lines.en: : I’ve never gone to another bar before...
lines.zh: : 我从来没去过别家的酒吧……

lines.en: : You know this isn't a bar, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道这不是酒吧吧？

lines.en: : Sana, it's clearly a full service restaurant. There are waiters and everything.
lines.zh: : Sana，这明摆着是一家全套服务的餐厅。连服务员都有。

lines.en: : But...my mom said-
lines.zh: : 可是……我妈妈说——

lines.en: : Your mom says a lot of things and it would probably be best to disregard most of them.
lines.zh: : 你妈妈说的话多了去了，大部分最好都别当真。

lines.en: : Well...either way...thank you...
lines.zh: : 嗯……不管怎样……谢谢你……

lines.en: scene sanabartwenty2
: I guess it’s...pretty easy to see why this place is better...right?
lines.zh: : 我想……为什么这地方更好，应该挺容易看出来的……对吧？

lines.en: : It’s...really nice in here...
lines.zh: : 这里面……真的很舒服……

lines.en: : I bet our...waitress will be really nice too...
lines.zh: : 我猜我们的……女服务员也会很亲切……

lines.en: A moment of silence passes by as Sana begins to observe the layout of the place.
lines.zh: 一阵沉默过去，Sana 开始打量起店里的布局。

lines.en: scene sanabartwenty2r
But unfortunately, before she's able to take in all of it, someone unexpected shows up.
lines.zh: 可不幸的是，她还没来得及看个遍，一个意想不到的人出现了。

lines.en: scene sanabartwenty3
: You brought a {i}child{/i}?
lines.zh: : 你带了个{i}小孩{/i}？

lines.en: scene sanabartwenty4
: Ch...Child? No...I’m-
lines.zh: : 小、小孩？不，我——

lines.en: : Sana, I’ll handle this.
lines.zh: : Sana，这个我来应付。

lines.en: : Talking to her is beyond your current skill level, I’m afraid.
lines.zh: : 跟她说话恐怕超出你目前的技能等级了。

lines.en: scene sanabartwenty5
: Wh-What?...
: Explain yourself, Hamburger Man.
lines.zh: : 解释一下，汉堡人。

lines.en: : Um...do you...know this girl, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 嗯……你……认识这个女孩吗，老师？

lines.en: : I do. Her name is Kaori, but she also goes by the Mistress of the Queen of the Spider Dark or something.
lines.zh: : 认识。她叫 Kaori，不过她也自称什么蛛暗女王之主之类的。

lines.en: : The...what?...
lines.zh: : 什么……之主？……

lines.en: : Hamburger Man, I can not provide dizzy drinks to this undersized human.
lines.zh: : 汉堡人，我不能给这个尺寸不足的人类提供晕眩饮料。

lines.en: : That’s fine because this is a restaurant and not a bar. Not everyone has to drink.
lines.zh: : 没关系，因为这是餐厅不是酒吧。也不是非喝不可。

lines.en: : All of the other human customers order the dizzy drinks. I can not make special exceptions just because this human is not fully grown.
lines.zh: : 其他所有人类顾客都点晕眩饮料。我不能因为这个人类还没长成就给她开特例。

lines.en: scene sanabartwenty4
: Um...would I be able to...maybe have a glass of water?
lines.zh: : 嗯……我能不能……也许要一杯水？

lines.en: : Does...that count as a...
lines.zh: : 那……算不算……

lines.en: scene sanabartwenty6
: OKAY NEVER MIND! SORRY I ASKED!
lines.zh: : 算了当我没说！对不起我不该问的！

lines.en: : You are a strange creature. Perhaps...{i}a cyclops?{/i}...How do you know the Hamburger Man?
lines.zh: : 你是个奇怪的生物。莫非是……{i}独眼巨人{/i}？……你是怎么认识汉堡人的？

lines.en: : Tell me immediately, miniature human cyclops girl!
lines.zh: : 立刻回答我，迷你人类独眼巨人女孩！

lines.en: : I D-D-D-DON’T KNOW ANY HAMBURGER MAN! I SAID I’M SORRY! PLEASE DON'T HURT ME!
lines.zh: : 我、我、我、我不认识什么汉堡人！我都说了对不起了！请不要伤害我！

lines.en: : Kaori, it’s probably best to leave her alone until I progress further into her story.
lines.zh: : Kaori，在我把她的故事线推进得更深之前，你最好还是别去招惹她。

lines.en: scene sanabartwenty7
: What is this ‘story’ you speak of? Can it fit in a box?
lines.zh: : 你说的这个“故事”是什么？能装进盒子里吗？

lines.en: : Do {i}I{/i} have a story? What color is it?
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}有故事吗？它是什么颜色的？

lines.en: : Everyone has a story. Yours just hasn’t started yet.
lines.zh: : 每个人都有故事。你的只是还没开始而已。

lines.en: : Order something now, please.
lines.zh: : 现在请点单。

lines.en: : I’ll have a-
lines.zh: : 我要一个——

lines.en: : No hamburgers.
lines.zh: : 不准点汉堡。

lines.en: : But I-
lines.zh: : 可是我——

lines.en: : Absolutely no hamburgers, Hamburger Man. You will become one if you continue to live purely off of them.
lines.zh: : 绝对不准点汉堡，汉堡人。你再继续光靠那玩意儿活着，你自己就要变成汉堡了。

lines.en: : Just get me whatever dish you recommend. And a beer.
lines.zh: : 那就上你推荐的菜吧。再来杯啤酒。

lines.en: : Understood.
lines.zh: : 明白了。

lines.en: : Or, as I have learned to say from the cooking-man in the shiny back room, “heard.”
lines.zh: : 或者按我从后面那个亮闪闪房间里的料理男那儿学来的说法——“收到。”

lines.en: : I will retrieve your items now. Please do not allow your human daughter to consume any dizzy drinks in the meantime.
lines.zh: : 我现在就去取你的东西。在此期间，请不要让你的人类女儿摄入任何晕眩饮料。

lines.en: scene sanabartwenty8
Kaori leaves as quickly as she appeared and I’m alone with my human daughter again.
lines.zh: Kaori 来得快去得也快，我又跟我的“人类女儿”单独待在了一起。

lines.en: : It’s okay, Sana. She’s gone now.
lines.zh: : 没事了，Sana。她走了。

lines.en: scene sanabartwenty9
: Who was she?! {i}What{/i} was she?! Why did she talk like that?!
lines.zh: : 她是谁？！她是{i}什么{/i}东西？！她为什么那样说话？！

lines.en: : There are many questions in life that I am unable to answer. This is one of those questions.
lines.zh: : 这世上有许多我回答不了的问题。这就是其中之一。

lines.en: : Why do you know her? Are you...secretly a...weird person?
lines.zh: : 你为什么会认识她？你……该不会其实是个……奇怪的人吧？

lines.en: Yes.
lines.zh: 是的。

lines.en: Probably not in...whatever way Sana is insinuating, but saying my habits are {i}not{/i} weird would be flat out lying.
lines.zh: 大概不是 Sana 暗示的那种奇怪，但要说我的癖好{i}不{/i}奇怪，那就是彻头彻尾的谎话了。

lines.en: : She’s just a waitress at some diner I’ve been to. And also at some bistro near the[school].
lines.zh: : 她只是我去过的一家餐馆的服务员。[school]附近那家小酒馆也有她。

lines.en: : And...also here now I guess?...
lines.zh: : 而且……现在这儿好像也有？……

lines.en: Just how many jobs does this girl have?
lines.zh: 这女孩到底打几份工啊？

lines.en: : People...{i}hired{/i} her? But...she’s so scary...
lines.zh: : 有人……会{i}雇{/i}她？可是……她好吓人……

lines.en: : You’re not talking about the tattoo, are you? I don’t think it’s that bad.
lines.zh: : 你该不会是说那个纹身吧？我觉得没那么糟。

lines.en: : She has a...tattoo?...I didn’t even see it...I had my eyes closed the whole time...
lines.zh: : 她有……纹身？……我根本没看到……我全程都闭着眼睛……

lines.en: : Yeah, she’s got a huge spider on her chest. Which makes it even stranger to me why so many places are hiring her.
lines.zh: : 是啊，她胸口有只大蜘蛛。这让我更想不通为什么这么多地方都肯雇她。

lines.en: : Maybe she’s...in the Yakuza?...
lines.zh: : 也许她是……黑道的？……

lines.en: : Yeah...I don’t really think Kaori is the Yakuza type.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我真不觉得 Kaori 是混黑道的那块料。

lines.en: scene sanabartwenty10
: Um...you don’t...also think I’m...a {i}child{/i}...do you?
lines.zh: : 嗯……你……不会也觉得我是……个{i}小孩{/i}……吧？

lines.en: s "Of course not. I mean, obviously you’re younger than me. But you’re
lines.zh: : “当然不会。我的意思是，你显然比我年轻。但你

lines.en: old enough to make your own decisions."
lines.zh: 已经大到可以自己做决定了。“

lines.en: : Kind of like you did tonight.
lines.zh: : 就像你今晚做的那样。

lines.en: scene sanabartwenty11
: Huh?...What do you mean by that?
lines.zh: : 咦？……你这话是什么意思？

lines.en: : Like how you didn’t want me spending time alone with your mom and decided to volunteer yourself instead.
lines.zh: : 就像你不想让我和你妈妈单独相处，于是主动提出要替她去一样。

lines.en: scene sanabartwenty12
: She...She told you that?!
lines.zh: : 她……她把那个也告诉你了？！

lines.en: : Was she not supposed to?
lines.zh: : 她不该说吗？

lines.en: : I...didn’t mean anything weird by it! I swear! I’ve just been meaning to visit this place for a while now!
lines.zh: : 我……我没有别的意思！我发誓！我只是早就想来这家店看看了！

lines.en: : I hear the...water is really good!
lines.zh: : 我听说这里的……水特别好喝！

lines.en: : I’m totally not afraid of you being alone with my mom! Why would I be?!
lines.zh: : 我才不怕你和我妈妈单独待在一起！我有什么好怕的？！

lines.en: : Sana, I'm going to need you to calm down. People are starting to look over-
lines.zh: : Sana，你冷静一下。大家开始看过来了——

lines.en: scene sanabartwenty13
: YOU TWO CAN BE ALONE WHENEVER YOU WANT AND I CAN’T STOP YOU!
lines.zh: : 你们俩想什么时候单独在一起都行，我拦不住你们！

lines.en: : Sana...please just-
lines.zh: : Sana……拜托你就——

lines.en: : YOU ARE...BOTH ADULTS!
lines.zh: : 你们……都是成年人！

lines.en: : YOUCANMAKEYOUROWNDECISIONS!
lines.zh: : 你们可以自己做决定！

lines.en: : Sana, you really need to-
lines.zh: : Sana，你真的需要——

lines.en: scene sanabartwenty14
: Okay, fine. We’re leaving.
lines.zh: : 好吧，行。我们走。

lines.en: : Sorry for causing a disturbance.
lines.zh: : 抱歉造成骚动。

lines.en: : I will remember this moment for all eternity.
lines.zh: : 我会永远记住这一刻的。

lines.en: : I’m sure you will. Come on, Sana.
lines.zh: : 我相信你会的。走吧，Sana。

lines.en: : I’MSOSORRY!
lines.zh: : 我真的很抱歉！

lines.en: scene black
Sana and I exit the rival {i}bar{/i} and begin to make our way back to Sara’s.
lines.zh: Sana 和我走出那家对手的{i}店{/i}，开始往 Sara 的酒吧走。

lines.en: Not wanting to explain the situation, I drop Sana off at the entrance and immediately begin to make my way home.
lines.zh: 我不想解释事情经过，于是把 Sana 送到门口，自己立刻动身回家。

lines.en: Here's hoping nothing like this ever happens again.
lines.zh: 只希望这种事别再发生了。

lines.en: And here's to that hope being nothing short of a pipe dream.
lines.zh: 也祝这份希望不过是一场白日梦。

$ sana_love += 1

lines.zh: {i}Sana 的好感度提升到了 [sana_love]！{/i}
